text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the Academy,
I caught sight of Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Truth be told, this morning's oracle
declared that silence invites good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, no, no, no...! Bad, bad...!
Today is Silent Day......—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Matikanefukukitaru hurriedly
left the area. However, some time later—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You folks are putting on
a guerrilla street live?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We saw this super awesome live video the other day!
And Turbo and the others wanna do an ultra-flashy,
super explosive street concert too~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But we're having trouble coordinating the venue~.
We want to make the audience feel all hyped and excited~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fuku-chan-senpai put on that legendary live before,
so we were wondering if we could borrow some of your wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, leave it to me!
I'll do a lucky coordination—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, loud voices are forbidden today...! U-Um...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're saying we should place Fuku-chan-senpai's
treasured lucky bottle cap on the stage?
Hm, hm... Got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the time for the live performance arrived—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—That was two songs in a row~!
Now then, our next song is~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...No fair~! We need to get way more hyped up,
or else Turbo won't accept this, no way, no way~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... what did you expect? That's about standard
for a makeshift girls' band slapped together on the fly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here is usually on the performing side of lives,
so their eyes and ears are quite discerning.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mumumu... Even though the Machikane crew
is working so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: B-But, I can't raise my voice today... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's raise our voices, everyone~!
Oh~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
............!
God, Shiraoki-sama, forgive meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
It's not really clicking, huh...
Guess I'll head back... hm?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
YEAAAAAAAH!!!!
THE GOOD FORTUNE FRONT HAS ARRIIIIIVED!!!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that... the legendary fortune guitarist,
Lucky Fukukita?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Receive our serious power wave before
you head home, everyoneeee!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~! Everyone's getting into the groove now~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, please listen to our next song!
"Tracen Ondo"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Matikanefukukitaru jumping in to play,
the live performance exploded with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ I'm so glad things got lively!
...I mean, that part is great, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu-gh! To ignore the oracle and unleash full-blown
raucous rock-and-roll sounds...! How utterly disrespectful of me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But, but, it felt like an instant explosion of energy!
It was super cool, you know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you stayed quiet until then made for
a really awesome build-up, in a way...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...C-Could it be?! Did the prophecy "silence invites good fortune"
foresee all of this from the start...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Maybe God saw right through you and knew
Fuku-chan-senpai would end up feeling like,
"I've gotta help them!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Uuu~! Praise be, praise be~!
I knew trusting the divine revelation was the right choice after all~!
